questions.topic: Module 5 · Control Relays and Motor Starters
questions.prompt: ★ What is the primary benefit of three-wire motor control over ordinary two-wire control after a power failure?
options: Allows starting only from multiple locations
Prevents automatic restart when power returns
questions.answer: Prevents automatic restart when power returns
questions.explanation: Loss of power drops the coil and opens the seal-in contact. A fresh Start command is needed after power returns.
questions.section: Module 5 · Control Relays and Motor Starters · motor 5-6.pdf · PDF page 4
